name: vi-bona-fide-residence
description: Decide whether a US citizen or resident alien is a bona fide resident of the US Virgin Islands for 2026 under section 937 and the IRS rules in Pub. 570, and whether Form 8898 is due. Covers the three separate tests (presence, tax home, closer connection), the five presence routes (183 days, 549 days over three years with 60 a year, 90 days or less in the US, USD 3,000 of US earned income with more days in the USVI, no significant connection to the US), how days are counted (medical treatment, disasters, up to 30 travel days, split days), the year-of-move exceptions, and Form 8898 for a move when worldwide gross income is over USD 75,000, with its USD 1,000 penalty. Trigger on "bona fide resident USVI", "Virgin Islands residency test", "183 days St. Thomas", "Form 8898", "moving to the USVI tax", "section 937", "closer connection USVI". Not the British Virgin Islands.
